title: Seabiscuit
description: A jockey (Tobey Maguire), an automobile magnate (Jeff Bridges) and a trainer (Chris Cooper) lead a racehorse to glory during the Great Depression.

title: Hey Arnold! The Movie
description: Arnold (Spencer Klein), Gerald (Jamil Walker Smith) and Helga (Francesca Marie Smith) try to stop a greedy developer from building a shopping mall.

title: Coach Carter
description: A high-school basketball coach (Samuel L. Jackson) turns a losing team around, then faces criticism for pushing the athletes to put grades first.

title: Selena
description: A beautiful Mexican-American singer's (Jennifer Lopez) skyrocketing international career ends abruptly.

title: Galaxy Quest
description: Aliens, believing actors to be real heroes, enlist cast members of a sci-fi TV series to help save their people.

title: Rosemary's Baby
description: A pregnant woman's (Mia Farrow) husband (John Cassavetes) and their satanic neighbors want her baby to be the Antichrist.

title: The Untouchables
description: Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness attempts to take Al Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force.

title: Jersey Girl
description: A young woman (Liv Tyler) changes the life of a single father (Ben Affleck) who used to be a successful New York music publicist.

title: Bon Voyage Charlie Brown (And Don't Come Back)
description: Snoopy plays Wimbledon on the way to France with exchange student Chuck and company.

title: Race for Your Life, Charlie Brown!
description: A thrilling raft race highlights the Peanuts gang's summer camp fun.

title: Snoopy, Come Home
description: The "Peanuts" gang becomes upset when the beloved beagle decides to leave home in search of his roots.

title: A Boy Named Charlie Brown
description: Charlie Brown wins a slot in the national spelling bee in the "Peanuts" gang's first big-screen adventure.

title: Free Birds
description: Two turkeys (Owen Wilson, Woody Harrelson) travel back in time to the year 1621 to prevent all feathered friends from ever becoming holiday dinners.

title: The Mechanic
description: An elite hitman teaches his trade to an apprentice who has a connection to one of his previous victims.

title: Edge of Tomorrow
description: A soldier fighting aliens gets to relive the same day over and over again, the day restarting every time he dies.

title: Sahara
description: A treasure hunter (Matthew McConaughey) and his sidekick (Steve Zahn) join forces with a doctor (Penélope Cruz) to search for a Confederate ship in Africa.

title: A Perfect Murder
description: A commodities trader (Michael Douglas) takes action when his wife (Gwyneth Paltrow) has an affair with a bohemian painter (Viggo Mortensen).

title: Smart People
description: Recently widowed, a professor (Dennis Quaid) tries to juggle a new love (Sarah Jessica Parker) and an unexpected visit from his adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church).

title: We Were Soldiers
description: A lieutenant colonel and approximately 400 U.S. troops battle 2,000 North Vietnamese soldiers in 1965.

title: An Officer and a Gentleman
description: A hardened loner (Richard Gere) shapes up for a military drill instructor (Louis Gossett Jr.) and a factory girl (Debra Winger) from town.

title: The Weather Man
description: A Chicago weather forecaster (Nicolas Cage) tries to mend relations with his father (Michael Caine), his ex-wife (Hope Davis) and his two children.

title: Enemy at the Gates
description: A Nazi sniper (Ed Harris) travels to Stalingrad to find and kill a Russian sharpshooter (Jude Law), the hero of the propaganda campaign of a political officer (Joseph Fiennes).

title: Hostage
description: A former hostage negotiator (Bruce Willis) must take action when three carjackers hold a wealthy man (Kevin Pollak) and his children at gunpoint.

title: The Terminal
description: Unauthorized to enter the United States, an Eastern European (Tom Hanks) befriends a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones) while living in a New York airport.

title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
description: An ad exec and a shower-curtain-ring salesman become co-travelers on the way to Thanksgiving in Chicago.

title: Terms of Endearment
description: A strong-willed woman (Shirley MacLaine) and her equally independent daughter (Debra Winger) keep the lines of communication open as each deals with the curveballs life throws at them.

title: Piranha
description: Spring break turns gory at a popular waterside resort, where hundreds of prehistoric man-eating fish have come to dine on hapless humans.

title: Norbit
description: Though married to a terrible shrew, a man (Eddie Murphy) tries to figure out a way to be with his childhood sweetheart (Thandie Newton), who has just moved back into town.

title: First Blood
description: Green Beret veteran Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a Pacific Northwest sheriff (Brian Dennehy) and the National Guard.

title: Mr. Holmes
description: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement.

title: Serendipity
description: A man (John Cusack) and a woman (Kate Beckinsale) try to find each other after spending one night together 10 years earlier.

title: 48 HRS.
description: A rumpled detective gets a slick convict released into his custody for two days to help him find a murderer in San Francisco.

title: Apocalypse Now Redux
description: An Army agent (Martin Sheen) goes upriver into the heart of Cambodia to kill a renegade colonel (Marlon Brando).

title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
description: After serving time for a crime he did not commit, a vengeful barber (Johnny Depp) and his accomplice (Helena Bonham Carter) carve up unlucky customers and bake them in meat pies.

title: The Godfather, Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
description: Dignified Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) joins his wild nephew in a Sicilian vendetta involving the Vatican.

title: The Wedding Singer
description: A wedding singer loses all hope when he is abandoned at the altar by his fiancée. He meets a young woman named Julia, who enlists his help to plan her wedding. He falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married.

title: Old School
description: Three friends try to recapture the fun of their college years by starting their own off-campus fraternity.

title: Saving Private Ryan
description: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

title: The Hunt for Red October
description: Moscow, Washington and a CIA analyst (Alec Baldwin) track a renegade Soviet captain (Sean Connery) and his new submarine.

title: The Experts
description: The KGB shanghais a hip New Yorker and his sidekick to teach square spies how to act like Americans for a secret mission.

title: Galaxy Quest
description: Aliens, believing actors to be real heroes, enlist cast members of a sci-fi TV series to help save their people.

title: Shall We Dance?
description: A married Chicago attorney (Richard Gere) takes dancing lessons with a beautiful woman (Jennifer Lopez) he saw through a window.

title: Edge of Tomorrow
description: A soldier fighting aliens gets to relive the same day over and over again, the day restarting every time he dies.

title: Twister
description: Storm-chasers (Helen Hunt, Bill Paxton) finalizing their divorce try to place equipment inside a tornado on the Oklahoma plains.

title: Flags of Our Fathers
description: Some of the servicemen who raised the U.S. flag on Mount Suribachi during the Battle of Iwo Jima at the end of World War II live to hear of their status as heroes.
